market_context.summary: Nifty 50 closed Friday at 25,030 (+2.0%), its 7th straight gain and a nine-month high above 25,000, led by banks. After a run like this, Monday can see profit-taking, so only strong stock-specific news is worth trading. Q2 results season continues all week; avoid stocks reporting during market hours.

picks.catalyst: Q2 FY27 profit +59% YoY to ₹7,533 cr, revenue +39%, beating estimates (results Fri 6 Nov)
picks.reasoning: A clear beat on higher aluminium prices, after a record Q1. On Friday the stock opened about 5% lower (₹891, likely on its US arm Novelis's results a day earlier), then rallied 7.5% off the low after Hindalco's own numbers to close at ₹958.40, up 2.2%. That reversal on heavy volume favours follow-through on Monday. Only buy near Friday's close: do not chase a gap above ₹965.
picks.risk: The rally came late on Friday; profit-taking after a 7-day market run could erase it. Novelis (US arm) tariff commentary is a known swing factor.

avoid.reason: Q2 profit fell 17% and the stock dropped ~10% on Friday. Don't try to catch the fall.

notes: First plan. Weekend draft from Friday's news; the Monday 08:40 IST run replaces it once automation is connected. One pick only: nothing else in the news met the bar.
